properties.description: HostRule (loopback plus --http-allow-host, extended and never replaced; matching kept identical in meaning to rmcp 3.4's) and HostGate, a tower service that serve_http puts in front of whatever it serves: single-design --http, the --serve-shared daemon, the --registry-root router (before routing) and the degraded surface. rmcp's own copy of the check is disabled where the config is built, so there is one owner. A refusal is a plain-text 403 naming the Host it saw, the allowed hosts and the exact flag; stderr logs the same fix once per distinct refused host, capped at 32. Added 2026-09-28 for GitHub issue #616 (fact:root-cause-the-host-refusal-is-the-librarys-opaque-403-and-the-fix-is-named-only-at-startup-2026-09-28).
properties.name: host_gate.rs — the Host allowlist, owned by reflow2 in front of every HTTP surface; a refusal names the host, the allowed hosts and --http-allow-host
